title: ChatGPT-generated C programming practice assessment items
summary: Educators use ChatGPT to generate short-answer and multiple-choice practice questions for an introductory C programming course. Specialists review each item for alignment with course objectives, cognitive level, validity, clarity, and technical correctness before student use.

sources.title: Enhancing STEM Education with ChatGPT: A Case Study on Developing Practice Assessments for C Programming
sources.evidence_quote: An experiment was designed using ChatGPT to generate practice problems aligned with specific course objectives for a Computer Science introductory programming course.
